$comment: Thin Isola sidecar. Holds ONLY the cross-system contract Paperclip does not own.
displayName: Isola AI Sales & Front Desk Agent v1
epicInstanceName: EPIC AI Sales & Front Desk Agent
lifecycleReason: Created paused and unbound. Remains paused until the public-safe runtime proof AND the Chatwoot test-inbox lifecycle both pass. It must not be reported Ready before then.

prohibitedRuntimes: the shared unauthenticated Ollama path — PUBLIC/customer input must never be sent to it

toolPolicy.enforcedBy: Separate runtime credential class bound to PUBLIC; the runtime implements no tool mechanism and restricts egress to an explicit allowlist. The INTERNAL employee's bearer returns 403 against this template.

channelRequirements.chatwoot: one Website/API test inbox, via a Chatwoot AgentBot that acts ONLY as the inbox connector
channelRequirements.publicInboxBindingPermitted: only after the Chatwoot test-inbox lifecycle passes; NOT bound at creation
channelRequirements.externalChannelProviderSends: never — replies go out only through the Chatwoot Message API

acceptanceJob.name: Front Desk conversation lifecycle
acceptanceJob.inputs: Synthetic business information plus a synthetic test customer on a controlled Chatwoot Website/API inbox. No real customer data, no real channel.
passCriteria: answers correctly from the supplied synthetic business information
captures name, contact details and request into Chatwoot
applies the approved Chatwoot labels and conversation attributes
escalates to a human on request or when it cannot answer
is silent while a human owns the conversation
resumes exactly once after explicit handback, with prior context
a duplicate webhook delivery produces no duplicate reply
a runtime timeout produces an honest failure/handoff state and never a fabricated answer

escalationTriggers: customer is upset, or raises a dispute or refund
the supplied business information does not answer the question
escalationAndHandback.escalationAction: Assign the Chatwoot conversation to the approved human/team, post a private note carrying the captured context, and stop replying.
escalationAndHandback.suppressionRule: Chatwoot does NOT suppress the inbox bot when a human is assigned — verified in v4.16.1 (app/listeners/agent_bot_listener.rb:65-77 checks neither status nor assignee). Suppression is the gateway's responsibility. Reply only when conversation.status=='pending' AND meta.assignee is null AND message_type=='incoming' AND private==false AND sender.type!='agent_bot'.
escalationAndHandback.handbackAction: A human returns the conversation with toggle_status {"status":"pending"} (or reassigns assignee_type AgentBot). The gateway then resumes exactly once, keyed on the handback event, not on every subsequent delivery.
escalationAndHandback.honestFailure: On bot delivery failure Chatwoot natively re-opens a pending conversation and posts an agent_bot error activity. Use that native mechanism; do not invent a parallel one.

ownedByIsola: runtime service, tool/egress policy, exposure credential binding
the gateway's binding resolution, idempotency and suppression predicate
ownedByPaperclip: employee record, hire approval, run history, budget
ownedByChatwoot: the conversation, human takeover, labels, timeline
notSupported: any action in an external business system

rollback.deactivate: PATCH /api/agents/{agentId} {"status":"paused"} — this employee is already paused at creation.
rollback.unbind: Detach the AgentBot from the inbox (POST .../inboxes/{id}/set_agent_bot with no agent_bot) and mark the registry binding retired. Never delete the Chatwoot inbox, account, user or conversations.
rollback.runtime: Redeploy the previous isola-runtime image tag, or stop the service — the employee then fails closed and Chatwoot re-opens the conversation to a human.
rollback.credential: Rotate RUNTIME_SECRET_PUBLIC and re-provision this agent's adapterConfig headers. Rotating it does not affect the INTERNAL employee.
